from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PUBLISHER = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'universal_job_result_publisher.py'


def test_publisher_ignores_dynamic_published_timestamp_for_idempotency():
    text = PUBLISHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'def semantic_public_payload' in text
    assert 'canonical.pop(\"published_at_utc\", None)' in text
    assert 'semantic_public_payload(existing_public) == semantic_public_payload(public)' in text


def test_publisher_still_allows_real_state_changes_to_publish():
    text = PUBLISHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'canonical = dict(payload)' in text
    assert text.count('canonical.pop(') == 1
